## About this page

A place for items you would rather not have on show. Items on the shelf stay out of every list, search and autofill until you open it with your master password.

#### Why it is there

Some items should not appear when you open WM Pass in front of someone, or hand over an unlocked device for a moment: a second account, or a login you keep private.

#### How it works

To put an item on the shelf, choose **Move to hidden shelf** from its menu. To move several at once, select them and choose **Put on the hidden shelf**.

Type your master password here and choose **Open the shelf** to see what is on it. Open an item to change it, or choose **Remove from hidden shelf** from its menu to put it back in the list.

The shelf closes when you choose **Close the shelf**, and whenever the vault locks. Every unlock starts with it closed. Autofill never offers shelf items, even while the shelf is open.

Settings, Appearance, Sidebar can add a Hidden shelf tab, which opens the same shelf from the sidebar.

#### When to use it

For items you would rather nobody saw over your shoulder. If you might be made to unlock the vault and show what is in it, a [decoy vault](/guide/settings/security/#action-decoy-vault) fits better.

#### Limits

The shelf hides items. It does not encrypt them separately: anyone who knows the master password can open it, and someone who makes you unlock the vault can make you open the shelf too.

Backups, synced copies and the WM Pass vault export carry the shelf with them. The plain-text exports include shelf items; the KeePass export leaves them out.

The Health score still counts shelf items, and **Check every password** on the Breaches page skips them.

#### On Android

To put an item on the shelf, choose **Move to hidden shelf** on the item. To move several at once, select them and choose **Put on the hidden shelf**.

Type your master password here and tap **Open the shelf** to see what is on it. Open an item to change it, or choose **Remove from hidden shelf** to put it back in the list.

The shelf closes when you tap **Close the shelf**, when you leave this page, and whenever the vault locks. Every unlock starts with it closed. Autofill never offers shelf items, even while the shelf is open.

See also [The hidden shelf](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-shelf), [Decoy vault](/guide/settings/security/#action-decoy-vault), [Plain text](/guide/settings/export/#group-export-plain), [Sidebar](/guide/settings/navigation/).
